svg.text: Clara and the First Beautiful Pokemon — p2
PLACEHOLDER · characters: clara, pip · seed: None

text.tspan: Clara skipping across a rainbow rope-bridge from one cloud
island to the next, arms wide, big joyful bossy grin. Pip
holding onto her hoodie pocket for dear life, flame-tuft
streaming. Other cloud islands in the distance, sparkly sun.
Characters: CLARA: 5-year-old human girl, short and round, fair
white skin with pink cheeks, long honey-blonde hair to mid-back
with straight-across blunt bangs, huge sparkling blue eyes, big
tooth-gap grin, glittery pink hair bow on the right side, red
and white pokeball-print hoodie, denim shorts, red sneakers,
sticky-berry satchel across chest, big-eyed bright Pokemon-anime
cel-shaded style, default expression is a giant bossy smile with
one hand on hip | PIP: tiny round fire-mouse pokemon, fluffball
the size of Clara's hand, soft cream-orange fur with cream
belly, huge round black sparkle eyes, bright orange flame-tuft
